title: Herbitional App
description: An AI-powered medicinal plant recommendation app built as part of a Bangkit capstone project, combining machine learning with a healthcare-focused user experience.

details.overview: Herbitional App helps users discover medicinal plants and herbal remedies by analyzing symptoms and plant properties with a custom NLP recommendation model.

modelDevelopment: Built and trained an NLP-based recommendation model using TensorFlow
Preprocessed plant and symptom data to improve matching accuracy
Validated recommendations with sample herbal use cases
backendDevelopment: Implemented Flask API endpoints for symptom submission and recommendations
Designed data schema and integrated inference logic into the backend
Managed model prediction flow and API response formatting
uiUxDesign: Designed a user-friendly symptom entry flow with clear health guidance
Created responsive plant result cards and detail views
Improved usability through concise recommendation explanations

details.architecture: User Input → Flask API → TensorFlow Model → Recommendation Engine → Result Display
details.architectureDescription: The frontend sends user symptoms to the Flask backend, where the model evaluates plant matches and returns ranked herbal suggestions to the UI.
features: Symptom-based medicinal plant recommendation using NLP
Medicinal plant detail pages with benefits and usage notes
Interactive search and filter for plant categories
Responsive healthcare-focused interface for mobile and desktop

challenges.title: Data Quality
challenges.description: Cleaning and normalizing plant and symptom data was essential to produce accurate recommendations, so I developed preprocessing steps to standardize input terms.

challenges.title: Model Interpretability
challenges.description: Balancing recommendation accuracy with understandable output required tuning the model and adding clear explanation text in the UI.

challenges.title: User Experience
challenges.description: Designing a simple symptom workflow for non-technical users meant focusing on clear labels, intuitive inputs, and easy-to-read results.

results: Delivered an AI-driven recommendation app that connects user symptoms with herbal remedies
Built a functional Flask backend to support model inference and API responses
Created a polished UI for symptom entry and treatment suggestion browsing

title: IoT-Based Electric Scooter Monitoring System
description: An IoT-based monitoring system for rental electric scooters that combines embedded hardware, wireless communication, and a web dashboard for real-time tracking and safety monitoring.

details.heroTagline: An IoT-based monitoring system that enhances rental electric scooter safety through real-time tracking, emergency alerts, and long-range wireless communication.
details.overview: This project was developed as my undergraduate thesis to improve the safety of rental electric scooter users. The system combines custom embedded hardware, LoRa communication, GPS tracking, and a web-based monitoring dashboard to provide real-time location monitoring and emergency notifications over long distances.

embeddedSystemDevelopment: Designed and developed both transmitter and receiver devices.
Programmed microcontrollers for GPS tracking, sensor communication, and LoRa data transmission.
Integrated multiple hardware components into a complete monitoring system.
pcbDesignHardwareIntegration: Designed custom PCBs for both transmitter and receiver modules.
Assembled and tested electronic components into functional prototypes.
Performed hardware debugging and integration testing.
webDashboardDevelopment: Developed a web dashboard for real-time location monitoring.
Displayed GPS locations and device status through an intuitive interface.
Connected incoming IoT data to the monitoring dashboard.

details.architecture:
GPS Module
      │
      ▼
ESP32 Transmitter
      │
      ▼
LoRa Communication
      │
      ▼
ESP32 Receiver
      │
      ▼
MQTT Broker
      │
      ▼
Database
      │
      ▼
Web Monitoring Dashboard
details.architectureDescription: The transmitter collects GPS and safety information from the scooter and sends it to the receiver through LoRa. The receiver forwards the data via MQTT, allowing operators to monitor scooters through a web dashboard in near real time.
features: Real-Time GPS Tracking: Monitor scooter locations in real time through a web dashboard.
Long-Range LoRa Communication: Transmit monitoring data over long distances using LoRa technology.
Emergency Alert System: Send emergency notifications when the rider activates the emergency button.
Custom Embedded Hardware: Built using custom-designed transmitter and receiver PCBs.
Monitoring Dashboard: Visualize location data and device status through a web interface.

transmitter: Installed on the scooter and responsible for reading GPS coordinates
receiver: Connects the embedded system with the web dashboard

details.webDashboard: The dashboard provides operators with a centralized monitoring interface that includes live scooter locations, rider status, emergency alerts, device connection status, and scooter information.

challenges.title: Hardware Integration
challenges.description: Integrated multiple electronic components including GPS, LoRa modules, and microcontrollers into a reliable embedded system.

challenges.title: Long-Range Communication
challenges.description: Optimized LoRa communication to provide stable data transmission over extended distances.

challenges.title: System Integration
challenges.description: Connected embedded devices with the web monitoring dashboard to provide real-time data visualization.

results: Built an end-to-end IoT monitoring system combining embedded hardware, wireless communication, and a web dashboard.
Developed working transmitter and receiver prototypes for real-world testing.
Established reliable LoRa-based communication between devices.
Implemented GPS-based location tracking and emergency alert flow.
Connected the embedded system to a live monitoring interface for operators.

transmitter.title: ESP32 Transmitter (C++)
transmitter.description: Firmware untuk ESP32 Transmitter pada skuter yang membaca data GPS, memonitor tombol SOS, dan mengirim paket telemetri ke LoRa SX1278.

receiver.title: ESP32 Receiver (C++)
receiver.description: Firmware ESP32 Receiver sebagai gateway yang menerima paket LoRa dan meneruskannya ke MQTT Broker melalui jaringan Wi-Fi.

dashboard.title: Web Dashboard (JS - MQTT)
dashboard.description: Kode klien dashboard web yang menghubungkan ke MQTT broker melalui WebSocket, menerima update lokasi real-time, dan memindahkan marker Leaflet.js.

title: Mini Trading API
description: RESTful API engine for a simulated trading platform focused on transaction integrity, concurrency handling, and scalable backend architecture.
highlights: Service-Repository Pattern to separate business logic and database queries
Pessimistic Locking to prevent double-spending under concurrent requests
Redis caching and queue for faster processing and async workflows
Form request validation and rate limiting guards
Automated integration testing for core transaction flows

details.heroTagline: A RESTful backend API that simulates trading transactions with a focus on reliability, data consistency, and secure API design.
details.overview: Mini Trading API is a backend application developed to simulate trading transactions through a RESTful API. The project focuses on building reliable backend services, handling transaction workflows, validating requests, and maintaining data consistency while following clean API design principles.

backendDevelopment: Designed and developed RESTful API endpoints for trading operations.
Implemented business logic for transaction processing and validation.
Structured backend modules to improve maintainability.
apiArchitecture: Designed request and response structures for consistent API communication.
Implemented authentication and authorization mechanisms where required.
Applied input validation and error handling across API endpoints.
systemReliability: Maintained transaction consistency during trading operations.
Improved backend reliability through proper validation and exception handling.
Tested API functionality to ensure stable behavior across different scenarios.

details.architecture: HTTP Request → Controller Validation → Service Layer → Repository → MySQL + Redis Cache
details.architectureDescription: Requests are validated at the controller layer before business rules execute in the service layer. Database updates follow structured logic to maintain consistency and reliability across trading operations.
features: RESTful API: Well-structured API endpoints for trading operations.
Authentication: Secure access to protected API resources.
Transaction Processing: Handles simulated trading transactions with proper validation.
Data Validation: Validates requests to maintain data consistency.
Error Handling: Provides meaningful responses for invalid requests and system errors.

challenges.title: Transaction Consistency
challenges.description: Designed backend logic to ensure trading operations maintained consistent data throughout each transaction.

challenges.title: API Validation
challenges.description: Implemented request validation and structured error handling to prevent invalid operations.

challenges.title: Maintainable Architecture
challenges.description: Organized backend modules and business logic to simplify future development and maintenance.

results: Built a functional trading simulation API with structured backend logic.
Improved request handling and error responses for better API reliability.
Delivered a backend solution focused on consistency, maintainability, and clear API design.
